title: Solrise
description: A cozy vanilla+ experience! By Raid NXT.
body:
# Solrise
### A Cozy Minecraft Modpack

Solrise is a carefully crafted Minecraft 1.20.1 modpack built around one simple idea: every mod has a purpose. No filler, no bloat, just a world that feels warm, alive, and worth exploring. Whether you are settling into a quiet cottage by a lavender field or engineering a steam-powered railway across the continent, Solrise gives you the tools to make Minecraft feel like home again.

---

## World Generation

The overworld has been completely transformed. Terralith and Tectonic reshape the terrain into towering mountain ranges, sweeping valleys, and dramatic coastlines. Biomes O Plenty, Regions Unexplored, Wilder Wild, and Geophilic fill the world with hundreds of unique biomes, each with their own flora, fauna, and atmosphere. Nullscape overhauls The End, and Incendium brings eight brand new biomes to the Nether. Explorify and Structory scatter hidden points of interest across the landscape, rewarding players who wander off the beaten path.

---

## Building and Decoration

Solrise has one of the most comprehensive building and decoration setups of any cozy modpack. Handcrafted, Another Furniture, and Macaw's Furniture give you everything from kitchen counters to lounge chairs. Macaw's Doors, Windows, Roofs, Lights, and Bridges let you build structures that actually look architectural. Supplementaries, Decorative Blocks, Chipped, and Rechiseled fill in the gaps with hundreds of decorative options, block variants, and detail pieces. Whether you are building a medieval castle or a countryside bakery, you will not run out of tools to work with.

---

## Food and Farming

Farmer's Delight expands the cooking and farming system with new crops, a cutting board, and a cooking pot that lets you prepare real meals. Cooking for Blockheads adds a smart kitchen setup that shows every recipe you can make with what you currently have. Let's Do Bakery, Beach Party, and Vinery add pastries, tropical foods, and a full wine crafting system complete with aging barrels. Serene Seasons ties it all together by making crops grow at different rates depending on the time of year, encouraging players to plan ahead and build proper farms.

---

## Mobs and Wildlife

The world of Solrise is alive with creatures that feel like they belong there. Naturalist adds realistic wildlife including deer, bears, songbirds, and butterflies. Critters and Companions introduces tameable otters, ferrets, and sea bunnies. Friends and Foes brings back beloved mob vote losers like the Copper Golem. Ecologics adds biome-appropriate animals that slot naturally into their environments. Whisperwoods fills dark forests with mysterious glowing creatures and things that lurk in the shadows. The Graveyard introduces atmospheric undead structures and enemies that make exploring at night genuinely tense.

---

## Combat and Adventure

Better Combat overhauls the combat system with new animations and dual-wielding support. Artifacts scatters unique equipment across loot chests, each with special abilities tied to the Trinkets accessory system. Dungeons Arise and Dungeons and Taverns fill the world with massive hand-crafted structures worth raiding. The full YUNG's suite overhauled vanilla strongholds, dungeons, Nether fortresses, bridges, and witch huts. Bosses of Mass Destruction adds powerful custom bosses that make the endgame feel genuinely challenging. Lootr ensures every player gets their own loot from shared chests, so multiplayer never turns into a race.

---

## Automation and Engineering

Create brings a full mechanical engineering system to Solrise. Build contraptions powered by rotational force, automate resource processing, and engineer your own factories. Steam and Rails extends Create with a train system, letting you build railway networks across the world. Tom's Simple Storage connects all your chests into a single searchable network. Storage Drawers and Item Filters round out the storage setup for players who want everything in its place.

---

## Quality of Life

Xaero's Minimap and World Map let you track your exploration and set waypoints. Waystones provide fast travel between key locations. Jade displays block and entity information on hover. Inventory Profiles Next keeps your inventory sorted automatically. REI gives you a full recipe browser. Travelers Backpack adds portable storage with a built-in crafting table. Bountiful adds bounty boards to villages so there is always something to work toward. Numismatic Overhaul introduces a coin-based economy for trading with villagers and merchants. A full 20-chapter quest book guides players through every major system in the modpack from first night survival to endgame automation.

---

## Performance

Solrise is built to run well on modest hardware. The full optimization stack includes Sodium, Iris, Lithium, Ferritecore, ModernFix, C2ME, Noisium, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast, MoreCulling, Krypton, MemoryLeakFix, and several others. The minimum recommended RAM allocation is 6GB, making it accessible to players on laptops and mid-range machines.

---

## Requirements

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader 0.15.x or higher
- Minimum 6GB RAM allocated
- Recommended 8GB RAM for best experience

---
